ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high-intensity (white/tan) pixel ratio of approximately 9:1, localized within scarring and distal clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black primary pigmentation field; high-contrast white circular annuli (rings) distributed stochastically across the medial and lateral regions; dense, multi-tonal tan/white clusters localized at the extreme lateral distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior angle and significant bounding-box depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular, high-frequency serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude peaks concentrated on the inner trailing edge of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex trailing edge curve transitioning into jagged, irregular terminal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular white rings (annular scars) of varying diameters (approx. 5-15 pixels) distributed across the dark ventral surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (stalked barnacle colonies) present on both the left and right distal tips, creating significant irregular protrusions from the natural fluke boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The presence of highly distinct, isolated white circular 'donut' shapes against a near-uniform black background.
